2025-04-26
Reported a sideswipe while changing lanes, with the claimant's vehicle struck on the driver's side. The claimant has
retained counsel, and all further contact will go through the attorney's office.
2025-04-28
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant's vehicle in the lane change and lists the claimant as present in
the car at the scene.
2025-06-02
Two independent witnesses gave statements that match the claimant's description of the collision, and the other
driver confirmed the same sequence of events.
2025-06-15
Reviewed scene photos and the estimate. The damage to the side panels and mirror lines up with the impact
described by everyone involved, and no older damage is visible in the file.
2025-06-29
Checked the policy history. The coverage was in force well before the loss, and nothing in the records suggests the
vehicle damage predates the coverage start.
2025-07-03
The claimant's recorded statement through counsel describes the same sequence as the first contact. The account
has not changed in any conversation so far.
2025-08-22
The initial medical report documents neck and back strain, which fits the force and direction of a side impact of this
type. No prior treatment to the same areas appears in the records requested.
2025-08-28
Treatment began promptly after the accident. Visits have since increased and new services have been added month
after month, well beyond what is typical for a strain injury of this kind.
2025-08-30
Asked the treating provider for an updated plan of care and the rationale for the added services. Response from
counsel's office is pending.
2025-09-27
The driver of the veihcle lives in the policyholder's household and qualifies as a covered household member under
the policy. Coverage for the driver's involvement is confirmed.
2025-09-28
Sent the medical bills and records to the medical review unit for an evaluation of treatment frequency and the
services billed against the documented injury.
2025-10-09
Claim remains open. The liability picture is clear and the vehicle damage is consistent with the accident. Next step is
the medical review, and counsel will be updated once it is complete.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
